kind: Planning artifact only; no Round 2 implementation or agent execution claimed
title: Face and skin: diagnose residual stippling, author principal forms, verify expression
baseline_policy: Use the final published/frozen Round 1 source and capture identity when available; this plan does not invent that pending commit. Preserve original near hero de61dc4c470920eab6f3265bc5467da7f9fb33d6fae2129a9353e7ca6d24d3f5 as comparison and recovery input.
entry_conditions: Round 1 final film/default-anchor review and source publication complete with LIMITED art disposition.
Root freezes editable reconstruction, runtime/import inputs, skin maps, facial morphs and rig/LOD ownership.
Observe actual remaining stippling and principal facial limitations; retain accepted shadow depth0.2/normal0.35 as baseline.
shared_constraints: One 164-bone skeleton and unique existing face/morph writer; nine embedded GLB animations are distinct from the23-state external runtime library.
Original authored blend history is absent; committed reconstruction is editable imported data, not recovered modeling history.
Six concurrent workers plus root maximum; renderer alone owns heavy imports/Blender/renders. Schedule the artist export with that owner.
The rejected800-triangle temple wisps remain unbound; no unrelated map ornament, new abilities or backend expansion.
All candidate source/assets stay in fresh isolated scratch directories until source, numerical and actual-art review support promotion.
Preserve failed candidates and scoped evidence. No physical-GPU or commercial-quality claim from software capture timing.
dependency_schedule: Phase A: root freezes baseline; roles02/04/07 define context, action and source constraints; role06 produces fixed baseline.
Phase B: roles01/03/08 produce isolated skin/light/form candidates; role05 evaluates exact morph/action deformation; role14 integrates reviewed inputs in scratch.
Phase C: role06 records frozen candidates; roles09/10/11/12 review independent technical/pixel contexts; role13 measures actual candidate resources.
Phase D: owners correct demonstrated failures, affected checks/captures repeat, role15 delivers source-bound accept/reject decisions; root updates roadmap.

assignments.title: Skin material artist
assignments.task: Isolate the remaining scalp, ear and chest stippling, then author a skin-only material candidate from the accepted original maps. Preserve authored color, UVs, normal-frame conventions and makeup/jewelry boundaries.
dependencies: Round 1 final source freeze and accepted depth-bias 0.2 / normal-bias 0.35 profile
R2-06 baseline views and diagnostic capture contract
acceptance: Change one material variable per diagnostic candidate; include unchanged control and exact source hashes.
Residual stippling must diminish in matched front, three-quarter and ordinary-camera views without bleaching indigo/gold, losing skin form or adding waxy halos.
If maps change, retain generation parameters, exact channels, color-space intent, license and byte hashes.
rejection_gate: Reject a candidate accepted only from a different camera, exposure, pose, light or LOD.
Reject new color seams, UV changes, blurred face structure, unstable highlights or an unsupported claim that the prior shadow correction solved all skin defects.
assignments.runtime_write_authorization: No runtime promotion by this planning artifact; root owns reviewed integration.

assignments.title: Face-context artist
assignments.task: Prepare review fixtures using the current courtyard and Confluence backgrounds to test face/background separation and reflected-light context. Select existing architecture; add no new ornament.
acceptance: Provide fixed coordinates for close face and gameplay-scale face views against light stone, dark foliage and indigo/gold context in day/night.
Every fixture records original scene identity and the absence of changes to collisions, architecture and practical-light budgets.
rejection_gate: Reject a fixture that conceals the face with scenery, changes world materials to flatter one candidate or adds unrelated geometry.

assignments.title: Lighting diagnostician
assignments.task: Define and compare controlled skin-lighting probes around the accepted shadow policy, keeping artistic skin changes distinct from shadow/contact changes.
dependencies: Round 1 shadow ablation and accepted bias evidence
acceptance: Baseline retains sun shadows and depth 0.2 / normal 0.35; every probe alters exactly one declared variable and restores it.
Check face, ear, scalp, neck and chest alongside jewelry, foot and ground shadows in courtyard and Confluence day/night.
Any proposed policy change must reduce its named defect while preserving visible fixed-view contacts; moving-camera limits remain explicit.
rejection_gate: Reject disabling all shadows or hiding remaining defects with broad bloom, fog or overexposure as a production fix.
Reject detached contact shadows, eye-socket collapse, light leaks or a policy accepted solely from one face portrait.

assignments.title: Facial action-context designer
assignments.task: Build a deterministic shot list from the existing five accepted ability timelines to expose facial and neck deformation during aiming, draw, release, recoil and cancellation. Retain existing effects and gameplay.
acceptance: Each fixture names an existing ability, exact runtime event/phase, camera and required receiver receipt when claiming a hit.
Provide unobscured facial diagnostic takes and normal effects-on context takes; distinguish the two in metadata.
No damage, warning geometry, cooldown, projectile timing, gameplay camera or VFX design changes.
rejection_gate: Reject a pose-only action presented as an executed gameplay event, or a wall impact labeled target-hit evidence.
Reject added ornamental effects or face-only framing substituted for normal action visibility.

assignments.title: Facial deformation animator

dependencies: R2-08 isolated facial candidate and baseline geometry/morph manifest
Existing unique face writer and pause/reset contracts
acceptance: Check rest, individual and combined blinks, supported partial-blink targets, aim extremes and existing five-action poses.
Keep eye/eyelid contact, facial boundary continuity and deterministic pause/reset/cancel behavior.
Preserve the 164-bone skeleton, existing nine embedded animations and separate 23-state library unless a separately reviewed exception is explicitly proposed.
rejection_gate: Reject new eye penetration, lips separating into visible gaps, boundary cracks or changes to unrelated body locomotion.
Reject fixing a failed deformation by disabling the face writer, freezing expression or hiding eyes.

assignments.title: Capture engineer

acceptance: Freeze camera, viewport, exposure, lights, pose, near LOD and render settings for paired views; record all deviations explicitly.

dependencies: Round 1 retained skin diagnosis and source ledger
Current imported hero, texture files and reconstruction blend

assignments.title: Principal facial-form artist

acceptance: Record a bounded edit mask and before/after vertex/morph/skin differences; hold the face/body boundary and unrelated body/costume/bow data exact.
Keep bone hierarchy, skin ownership, UVs and morph naming/ordering; any necessary non-exact change must be explicit and separately reviewed.
Demonstrate stronger coherent eyelid/lip/chin planes in matched front/three-quarter views without losing recognizable features.
Produce an editable source and fresh external candidate; no direct write to runtime hero assets.
rejection_gate: Reject detached cosmetic wisps as a substitute for principal facial work.
Reject changed skeleton/weights, untracked topology/UV changes, boundary cracks, eye intersection, morphed-surface collapse or improvements visible only in a still rest pose.
